question: Do the original global carrier group and actual native cubic select a consistent source-level route to distinct Down/lepton masses and phases?
summary_de: Die globale SM-Quotientengruppe plus festes orientiertes Glue-Woerterbuch waehlt den minimalen Rand-Nullvektor und y=1 ohne extra Block-Permutationsannahme. Die echten E6-Cubic-Slots enthalten Down und Leptonen, aber ihr alternierender Familientensor ist als direkte lokale Weyl-Yukawa-Kopplung unvertraeglich und liefert im gerichteten Slot nur Rang2. Ein echter komplementaerer Massenkanal muesste beide fehlenden Richtungsueberlappungen tragen; seine reine Massenphase kuerzt sich aus der vollen chiralen Massendeterminante. Keine Feld-/Quellenherleitung oder TOE-Schliessung.
kills: The previous additional block-permutation premise is required once the auxiliary fields genuinely descend to the fixed global carrier group and oriented glue.
The global group alone, without the oriented dictionary, selects the null direction uniquely.
The actual bosonic d_ABC epsilon_ijk current tensor can directly be used as a local zero-derivative same-field 4D Weyl Yukawa tensor.
A single directed Higgs-family contraction of the actual cubic produces three nonzero distinct masses.
An arbitrary phase of only the heavy M supplies a phase to the full chiral mass determinant of the stated rank-two plus one-channel block.

The existing oriented E8 glue character is fixed
Auxiliary colour/weak singlets represent the actual global S(U3xU2), not just its Lie algebra
Previously certified native affine cubic, roots and cocycle conventions

All-generation physical Yukawas, mirror removal, 3+1D local continuum and quantum gravity
